concept: IAM: EC2 role via instance profile instead of long-term keys
tests: The most secure way to give an EC2 application access to AWS APIs (Secrets Manager) without storing permanent credentials.
expected: IAM role via instance profile: temporary, automatically rotated credentials from IMDS. Triggers: "EC2 needs to access", "without storing long-term credentials".
why_not: Keys in user data/env or in the AMI — secret leakage; root access keys must never be given to applications.
